mechanism: Rizatriptan (5-HT1B/1D agonist) combined with prochlorperazine (dopamine antagonist with some serotonergic activity) increases serotonin syndrome risk and additive CNS depression.
action: Monitor for serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, confusion, tremor, hyperthermia); use combination cautiously and consider alternative antiemetic if clinically feasible.
